title: A VPC with public and private subnets
claim: Route tables send a private subnet's internet traffic to a NAT gateway in a public subnet, and from there to the internet gateway.
alt: A VPC in one Region with an internet gateway. A public subnet holds a web instance and a NAT gateway. A private subnet holds a worker instance. Users reach the web instance through the internet gateway. The worker's requests go to the NAT gateway, then out through the internet gateway.

edges.say: A user's request reaches the internet gateway of the VPC.
The internet gateway delivers it to the web instance, which has a public IP address in a public subnet.
The worker in the private subnet sends a request to the internet, and its route table points to the NAT gateway.
The NAT gateway sends the request out through the internet gateway with its own public IP address.

edges.label: replies
edges.say: Replies come back the same way, and no host on the internet can start a connection to the worker.
